unit_of_analysis: one catalyst label; 3b syn/anti dynamic rows averaged within the published 3b yield row

outcome.name: yield_percent
outcome.source: attached article Table 1, 0.02 mol% Cu(I)-NHC condition

core_feature_rationales.d2_pocket_steric_entropy_sum: CREST ensemble steric-entropy occupancy mass; available when normalized entropy is not estimable
core_feature_rationales.d3_d2_delta_pocket_steric_entropy_sum: matched full-minus-IMe CREST ensemble entropy-occupancy difference
core_feature_rationales.d3_delta_g_percent_mean: dynamic d3 scalar G mean difference
core_feature_rationales.d2_displaced_g_mean_2: displaced dynamic G signal selected by the initial full-pool fit

feature_pool.feature_policy: archive all finite numeric d2 ensemble fields, matched full-minus-IMe d2 ensemble deltas, and dynamic d3 changed-area/scalar-comparison fields; fit only the mechanistically motivated core because n=7

model_policy: case-3d Gaussian Bayesian ridge with marginal-likelihood selection of at most three features; selection and hyperparameters are refit in every nested leave-one-catalyst-out fold

static_vbur_model.validation_note: fixed descriptor set; no nested subset selection

static_g_model.validation_note: fixed descriptor set; no nested subset selection

full_feature_ensemble_model.validation_note: full finite d2/d3-derived candidate pool; fixed-subset LOO shown, nested full-pool selection omitted because n=7

scientific_boundary: The yield fit is exploratory association over seven catalyst labels. It is not a causal mechanism, kinetic probability, free-energy model, or validation of xTB-constructed 3e/IMes/IPr geometries.

case3d_v2_static_protocol_model.feature_selection_method: minimum inner leave-one-catalyst-out RMSE over all 105 two-feature pairs on logit-transformed yield
case3d_v2_static_protocol_model.outcome_transform: logit(yield_percent/100); inverted with logistic function for yield-scale diagnostics
case3d_v2_static_protocol_model.validation_boundary: The selected pair is post-hoc for Case 3f. Fixed-pair LOO is conditional; nested LOO repeats the pair selection inside each held-out fold and is the selection-aware estimate.
